decisive_items: a markedly dilated right ventricle with severely reduced systolic function
arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia was highly suspected
response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states ARVD was highly suspected based on epsilon wave, T-wave inversions, RVOT dilation, and severe RV dilation/hypokinesia, which are classic criteria. Cardiac sarcoidosis is only mentioned as a remaining differential due to pulmonary nodules, without specific cardiac sarcoidosis findings.

rejected.why: Only supported by the presence of pulmonary nodules and a statement that it remained in the differential; the clinical and imaging findings strongly favor ARVD.
